name: Throatshards
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level bloodrager 4, magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a shard shard of glass)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial, see text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You summon sharp shards of glass into the throat of the target creature. At the beginning of their turn, the target must make a Fortitude save. On a failure, the target takes 2d4 magical slashing damage, 1 bleed damage, and is unable to speak or use spells or abilities that require vocal components or linguistic communication. On a failure, they only take 1d4 magical slashing damage but must make the save next round.

Creatures without throats are not affected. If the creature has multiple throats, it only prevents one throat from vocalizing.
